profile_text.body:
OctoAI is listed as a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, with octo.ai as its website. No products are tracked for it, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded.

The text gathered from the site does not describe OctoAI's own business. It is NVIDIA material, describing NVIDIA as the inventor of the GPU and as a maker of accelerated computing for AI, HPC, gaming, creative design, autonomous vehicles, and robotics. Among the items named in that text are NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, NeMo Switchyard, RTX, DLSS 4, the GeForce RTX 50 Series, Jetson, and Isaac, along with references to Perplexity's local agent on Windows RTX PCs and to an October 20 to 22 event. The same text states that Deci was acquired by NVIDIA Corporation of Santa Clara, CA in May 2024 and dissolved as a separate corporate entity.

The remaining held facts are sparse. Litigation exposure is recorded against Washington with a count of 114, while the case list itself is empty.
